request.style: English, uptempo celebratory gospel, strong male lead vocal with mass choir, Hammond organ, piano, slap bass, drums, tambourine, hand claps, joyful and fiery, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Fifty days from Passover they gathered in one place
A sound came down from heaven like a wind that filled the space
Tongues as of fire were dividing, one on every head
They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, speaking as the Spirit led

[Chorus]
I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh
Your sons and your daughters will prophesy
Your young men will see visions
And your old men will dream dreams
Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved

[Verse]
Parthians and Medes and Elamites, from Egypt and from Rome
Each heard the mighty works of God in the language of his home
Some were amazed and others mocked, they are full of new wine
Then Peter stood up with the eleven and he raised his voice on high

[Bridge]
This Jesus God has raised up
And of that we are all witnesses
Repent and be baptized, every one of you
And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit
The promise is for you and for your children
And for all who are far off

[Chorus]
I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh
Your sons and your daughters will prophesy
Your young men will see visions
And your old men will dream dreams
Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved

[Outro]
About three thousand souls were added that day
Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved
